description: useHomeFortune latched a persistent doneRef BEFORE its async work, so React StrictMode's dev double-invoke deadlocks the loading flag: run A latches + starts the fetch, its cleanup sets alive=false, run B short-circuits on the latch, then run A's fetch resolves into `if (alive)` (false) → setFortune AND `finally { setLoading(false) }` are both skipped → loading stays true → the /v2 ScoreRingCard shows FortuneSkeleton forever (no empty-state, no error). Console/AST are blind (the code shape is a valid effect); the request DOES fire and returns 200 — the bug is the discarded result, not a missing call — so a network probe alone mis-diagnoses it as 'no fetch'. Ground-truth = the rendered card leaves the skeleton within a time budget. Fix = drop the doneRef latch; the effect is idempotent, each StrictMode invocation owns its `alive`, the surviving run resolves loading (also fixes a latent no-refetch-on-userId-change). Dev-only (prod mounts once); /api/home-fortune is an idempotent daily compute so the dev double-call is harmless. Teeth-proven live (run-fortune-hang.ts, neg-control-first vs the real testenv stack): MUTANT=restore latch → skeleton persists 15s+, pulses=1 → runner exits 1 CAUGHT; FIX → skeleton clears ~1.5s, fortune 'B+ 70%' + ธาตุ line render → PASS. gate_layer=runtime/rendered-text; local-only (needs the testenv DB stack, like e2e/auth-loop — not in ci.yml/design-verify). ⚠️ enforced_by REMOVED 2026-08-07 (goo · harness-tidy ใบ ข · on บอง’s ruling): the anchor named here was MOVED to harness/archive/ — nothing runs it (not CI, not an npm script), so the field was advertising a guard that does not run (the shape ตู๋ caught in #189/#191). Rule: connect it or withdraw the claim, never leave the claim standing. The anchor FILE is kept in harness/archive/ (Rule 1 · Nothing is Deleted); to revive, wire it into CI first, then re-add enforced_by. WAS: harness/run-fortune-hang.ts#strictmode-hang
